Alpha Vantage API Documentation

Welcome to the Alpha Vantage API documentation. This comprehensive guide covers all available endpoints for real-time and historical financial data.

Stock Time Series Data

This section contains APIs for retrieving stock time series data including intraday, daily, weekly, and monthly prices.

TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY

This API returns intraday time series (timestamp, open, high, low, close, volume) of the equity specified.

Parameters

Name Type Description Default Options
function string The time series of your choice TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY
symbol string The name of the equity of your choice
interval string Time interval between two consecutive data points 5min 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min
apikey string Your API key
outputsize string By default, outputsize=compact compact compact, full

Python Code Example

import requests

# replace the "demo" apikey below with your own key from https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key
url = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY&symbol=IBM&interval=5min&apikey=demo'
r = requests.get(url)
data = r.json()

print(data)

Request Pattern

https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY&symbol=IBM&interval=5min&apikey=YOUR_API_KEY

TIME_SERIES_DAILY

PREMIUM ENDPOINT: This endpoint requires a premium subscription.

This API returns daily time series (date, daily open, daily high, daily low, daily close, daily volume) of the global equity specified.

Parameters

Name Type Description Default Options
function string The time series of your choice TIME_SERIES_DAILY
symbol string The name of the equity of your choice
outputsize string By default, outputsize=compact compact compact, full
apikey string Your API key

R Code Example

library(httr)

# replace the "demo" apikey below with your own key from https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key
url <- 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=TIME_SERIES_DAILY&symbol=IBM&apikey=demo'
response <- GET(url)
data <- content(response, "parsed")

print(data)

Request Pattern

https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=TIME_SERIES_DAILY&symbol=IBM&apikey=YOUR_API_KEY

Fundamental Data

This section contains APIs for retrieving fundamental data including company overview, income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.

OVERVIEW

This API returns the company information, financial ratios, and other key metrics for the equity specified.

Parameters

Name Type Description Default Options
function string The function of your choice OVERVIEW
symbol string The name of the equity of your choice
apikey string Your API key

VBA Code Example

Sub GetCompanyOverview()
    Dim url As String
    Dim xmlHttp As Object

    ' replace the "demo" apikey below with your own key from https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key
    url = "https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=OVERVIEW&symbol=IBM&apikey=demo"

    Set xmlHttp = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP")
    xmlHttp.Open "GET", url, False
    xmlHttp.send

    MsgBox xmlHttp.responseText
End Sub

Request Pattern

https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=OVERVIEW&symbol=IBM&apikey=YOUR_API_KEY

INCOME_STATEMENT

This API returns the annual and quarterly income statements for the company of interest.

Parameters

Name Type Description Default Options
function string The function of your choice INCOME_STATEMENT
symbol string The name of the equity of your choice
apikey string Your API key

MATLAB Code Example

% replace the "demo" apikey below with your own key from https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key
url = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=INCOME_STATEMENT&symbol=IBM&apikey=demo';
data = webread(url);

disp(data);

Request Pattern

https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=INCOME_STATEMENT&symbol=IBM&apikey=YOUR_API_KEY

Currency Exchange

This section contains APIs for retrieving currency exchange rates and currency exchange time series.

CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE

This API returns the realtime exchange rate for any pair of digital currency (e.g., Bitcoin) or physical currency (e.g., USD).

Parameters

Name Type Description Default Options
function string The function of your choice CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE
from_currency string The currency you would like to get the exchange rate for USD, EUR, GBP, etc.
to_currency string The destination currency for the exchange rate USD, EUR, GBP, etc.
apikey string Your API key

JavaScript Code Example

// replace the "demo" apikey below with your own key from https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key
const url = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE&from_currency=USD&to_currency=JPY&apikey=demo';

fetch(url)
  .then(response => response.json())
  .then(data => console.log(data))
  .catch(error => console.error('Error:', error));

Request Pattern

https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE&from_currency=USD&to_currency=JPY&apikey=YOUR_API_KEY

Getting Started

To get started with the Alpha Vantage API:

  1. Get your free API key from our website
  2. Choose the endpoint that fits your needs
  3. Make your first API call
  4. Parse the JSON response

Note: The free tier allows 5 API requests per minute and 500 requests per day.
